title: applied-ml-experiment-scratchpad-2026-03-24
content:
Daily scratchpad -- quick log for quant/eval work (choppy notes)

Goal:
- sanity-check q4_0 vs q8_0 vs fp16 on downstream QA/eval sets; measure latency/throughput and answer: is q4_0 regression acceptable for interactive SLOs?

Context:
- model: redwood-open-7b (internal build)
- infra: dedicated-dev pool (A100s), sequence distribution skewed to 512/1024 token requests
- prior baseline (fp16): median latency @512 = 48ms/token, throughput 220 tokens/s per GPU (batch=8)

Quick commands run:
- python eval/eval_cli.py --model redwood-open-7b-q4_0 --prompts eval/qa/seedset-1.jsonl --batch 8 --seq 512 --out out/q4_0_seed1.jsonl
- python perf/measure.py --model redwood-open-7b-q8_0 --batch-size 8 --seq 512 --iters 200

Results (first pass, note: noisy perf runs)
- fp16 (baseline): EM: 72.4, F1: 81.1, median latency @512: 48ms/token, tokens/s: 220
- q8_0: EM: 72.2, F1: 80.9, median latency @512: 46ms/token, tokens/s: 235 (slightly faster)
- q4_0: EM: 69.6, F1: 78.0, median latency @512: 43ms/token, tokens/s: 260 (best perf but accuracy drop ~2.8 EM)

Observations:
- q4_0 gives good perf gains but consistent small drop on QA metrics. Regression concentrated on numeric/scalar answers (dates, counts).
- Qualitative check: hallucination rate up for list-type prompts (prompt set QA-list). Need targeted eval.
- p99 tail latencies unchanged -- improvement mostly in throughput and median, not tail. Might be due to kernel scheduling/backpressure.

Hypotheses to test:
- numeric tokens sensitive to quantization; maybe per-channel symmetric vs asymmetric quantization matters. Try q4_1 variant or per-op calibration.
- try selective fp16 for LayerNorm + output heads (mixed quant) to recover EM without major perf hit.

To-do (short):
- [ ] run targeted eval on numeric QA subset (seedset-numeric) with q4_0, q4_1, q8_0, fp16 (JIRA-ML-721) -- low priority tasks can be parallelized with Maya
- [ ] try mixed-precision config: keep lm_head + final layer fp16 (quick patch in export script)
- [ ] reproduce perf runs with stable perf harness (disable background jobs on dev pool) -- variance high today
- [ ] write short notes for PR: serving-runtime change to support per-op quant config (link to PR draft)

Notes / fragments:
- prompt set examples that fail under q4_0:
  "Q: How many countries border Germany?" -> q4_0: "four" (wrong) vs fp16: "nine" (correct)  check tokenization differences? unlikely but list.
- calibration: used 1024 sample tokens clip; try 5k tokens and per-layer-wise minmax vs KL-based calibrator.

Next steps for tomorrow:
- run numeric-only eval (Maya) + mixed-precision experiment (me) + short debug trace on one failure example (Asha)
- prepare short mini-PR to add q4_1 variant to model catalog for internal tests (if results promising)

Open Qs / blockers:
- do we have CPU fallback metrics cost model for q4_0 when routing fallback occurs? Need input from cost team. (tag: @finance)
- perf harness: request SRE to pin nodes for stable runs? file ticket with infra.

Random notes:
- save important outputs to gs://redwood-experiments/q4_0/2026-03-24/
- logs: out/q4_0_seed1.jsonl + perf logs in perf/logs/2026-03-24/

---
Rough rough, TODOs above. Will clean up into a proper experiment log if one of the configs looks promising.
